about: T091 cost-of-capital lens (scripts/article/analysis/t091/run_wacc_lens.mjs + analyse_wacc_lens.py): the cheapest build at 90% uptime in the atlas's full Local mode (each region's own cost of capital, local capex), app defaults; per region in the summary's cell order; null where 90% is not met. `wacc` is the article's common cost of capital (the atlas's WACC Global), for the labels.
